50 km/hr, at an angle \(\tan^{-1}\left(\frac{3}{5}\right)\) east of south

The equation of motion of a projectile is \(y = ax - bx^2\), where a and b are constants of motion. Match the quantities of Column – I with the relations of Column – II and mark the correct choice from the given codes.

| Column – I | Column – II |
|---|---|
| (i) The initial velocity of projection | (p) \(\frac{a}{b}\) |
| (ii) The horizontal range of projectile | (q) \(a\sqrt{\frac{2}{bg}}\) |
| (iii) The maximum vertical height attained by projectile | (r) \(\frac{a^2}{4b}\) |
| (iv) The time of flight of projectile | (s) \(\sqrt{\frac{g(1 + a^2)}{2b}}\) |
options: i – p, ii – q, iii – r, iv – s
i – s, ii – p, iii – q, iv – r
i – s, ii – p, iii – r, iv – q
i – p, ii – s, iii – r, iv – q
reasoning: Compare with y = x tan(theta) - (g/2u^2cos^2)x^2: a=tan(theta), b=g/(2u^2cos^2). u = \(\sqrt{g(1+a^2)/2b}\) (s), range = a/b (p), max height = a^2/4b (r), time of flight = a\(\sqrt{2/bg}\) (q). So i-s, ii-p, iii-r, iv-q.
